text: dsh-gpu 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 GPU 执行插件，为 agent 提供显卡状态查询、按空闲程度选择显卡执行命令，以及启动和管理后台 GPU 作业的工具。它通过 DSH 的工具注册和 shell 执行接口工作，也可在合适的步骤注入 GPU 状态摘要。主要功能包括查看各卡显存、利用率与温度，执行单次或多卡命令，以及返回后台作业编号供后续查看或停止。适合在装有 NVIDIA GPU 的本地或远程执行环境中运行 CUDA 工作负载；需要执行主机提供 nvidia-smi，后台作业还需 jobs 服务。

dsh-gpu adds GPU tools to DeepSeek Harness: inspect device status, run commands on automatically selected or pinned GPUs, and launch background jobs. It uses the mounted shell and can inject a GPU summary into agent steps. The host needs nvidia-smi; background jobs require the jobs service.
想让 DSH 按显卡空闲程度自动挑一张卡运行命令。
怎么查看每块 NVIDIA 显卡的显存、利用率和温度？
我需要在 DSH 里指定某个 GPU 来执行 CUDA 命令。
能不能一次为一个命令选择多张空闲显卡？
想把训练任务放到后台运行，并稍后查看输出或停止它。
让 agent 在开始每一步前能看到当前 GPU 状态。
I want DSH to choose an available GPU before running a command.
How can I inspect memory use and utilization for every NVIDIA GPU?
dsh-gpu 的功能「GPU 状态查询」：调用 gpu_status 查询执行主机上的 NVIDIA 显卡，返回每张卡的显存、利用率、温度及空闲状态；没有可用设备时返回 no-gpu 说明。
dsh-gpu 的功能「GPU 命令执行」：调用 gpu_exec 运行一次命令，可自动选择较空闲显卡、固定 gpuIndex 或请求多卡，并将选择写入 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES。
dsh-gpu 的功能「后台 GPU 作业」：调用 gpu_run_bg 启动长时间运行的命令并立即取得 job id，之后可通过作业工具读取输出或停止任务。
dsh-gpu 的功能「步骤 GPU 状态提示」：开启 stepContext 后，在符合条件的 agent step 中加入 GPU 状态摘要，并按 refreshIntervalMs 限制采样频率。

dsh-gpu README · dsh-gpu：GPU-aware execution layer for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh). Out-of-tree plugin; no harness patches required.

Agents get three tools — `gpu_status`, `gpu_exec`, `gpu_run_bg` — plus an optional per-step GPU context line. Cards are selected automatically (freest first) with `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES` set in the command environment; pin a card explicitly when you care.

dsh-gpu README · How it works：- **`gpu_status`** — one query, every device: memory used/total, SM utilization, temperature, and a free/busy verdict. A device is *busy* at or above 80% memory used or 50% utilization (both configurable).
- **`gpu_exec`** — one-shot command with a selected card: `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<freest>` is passed through the mounted `ctx.shell` executor's environment. Auto-select or pin `gpuIndex`; select `count` cards for multi-GPU commands.
- **`gpu_run_bg`** — long-running GPU jobs (training, inference servers, benchmarks) register as a `gpu` job in `ctx.jobs`: returns a job id immediately, read with `job_output`, stop with `job_kill`.
- **Per-step context** (optional, on by default) — injects a one-line GPU snapshot into eligible steps (the `time-context` pattern), rate-limited to one sample per minute.

dsh-gpu README · How it works：All execution rides the **mounted shell executor**. Local host, or any remote execution world (e.g. an SSH provider plugin) — dsh-gpu doesn't know or care where the GPUs are; it queries and launches through the same seam the `bash` tool uses.

dsh-gpu README · Install：dsh-gpu is an out-of-tree bundle plugin. Install and activate it in a profile with the official plugin command:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-gpu
```

dsh-gpu README · Install：Load order note: place it after your execution-world plugins (e.g. an SSH provider) so the shell seam it queries is the one you intend.

    stepContext: true      # per-step GPU snapshot line (default true)

dsh-gpu README · Notes & gotchas：- `nvidia-smi` **ignores** `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES` — it always reports physical indices. `gpu_exec` selection still works as intended for CUDA programs; just don't use nvidia-smi output inside `gpu_exec` to verify the pinning.
- Selection is advisory, not a reservation: two concurrent agents can still pick the same card. For exclusive claims, pin `gpuIndex` from a `gpu_status` read in the same step.
- `gpu_run_bg` requires the jobs service in the composition (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-jobs` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs`), the same dependency background `bash` has.
- Hosts without NVIDIA GPUs: `gpu_status` reports a clean `no-gpu` result instead of failing.
